step_by_step_reasoning:
The whiteboard shows a cross-account deployment pipeline architecture separated into HUB and SPOKE accounts.

1. Actors & Hub Provisioning:
   - Deployment Engineer (UserCompanyDeveloper) interacts with CloudFormation in the Hub account.
   - CloudFormation triggers/creates Lambda, Service Catalog (Hub), and CodePipeline.
   - Lambda configures/shares Service Catalog in the Hub account and establishes shares/constraints with Service Catalog in the Spoke account.
   - Service Catalog (Hub) connects to Service Catalog (Spoke) via portfolio sharing.

2. App Dev CI/CD Workflow:
   - App Dev (UserCompanyDeveloper) pushes updates to CodeCommit.
   - CodeCommit triggers CodePipeline.
   - CodePipeline updates/publishes products to Service Catalog (Hub).
   - Products in Service Catalog (Spoke) deploy resources into the Spoke account (e.g., EC2).
